coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: National (INPS). Pre-hire communication due by 24:00 the day before start; quarterly contributions due 10 Apr/Jul/Oct/Jan, paper slips dropped in 2026, payment via INPS portal/app IO/PagoPA. INPS free simulation tool; paid Excel payslip sheets; CAF services around EUR 25/month via WhatsApp (Centro Fiscale). Served by free state tool, CAFs and patronati. Weak candidate only.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No Italian register for base-metal scrap dealers found (TULPS art.128 register is for cose antiche/usate; compro-oro regime covers precious metals only). Scrap is handled via waste rules (RENTRI/FIR, Albo gestori, reverse charge) = K14. Nothing new beyond K14.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Daily register of operations under TULPS art.128 + DM 95/2009 still in force (MISE resolution 120995 of 26 Mar 2018 after SCIA reform). No dedicated software or electronic filing found in search; format (paper vidimato vs electronic) unconfirmed. Pawnbrokers (Monti di pieta) not searched. One weak candidate.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Compro-oro OAM regime (D.Lgs. 92/2017), questura attestation, 24h reporting to questura: nothing new beyond K18.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Handled under RENTRI (register monthly transmission, digital FIR from 13 Feb 2026); vendors Aruba RENTRI Smart, PrometeoRifiuti, Rifiutoo. Nothing new beyond K14. No dismantler-specific obligation found.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: D.Lgs. 134/2022 (I&R system) and 136/2022. A regional resolution says that from 1 Jan 2026 completing the mandatory training is a condition for registering operators and transporters in the I&R system (transition ended 31 Dec 2025). Training-led, not software-led. Could not confirm the movement-register duty (text not found).

coverage.found: Slaughterhouse must register and report slaughtered cattle to BDN; Mod. 4 electronic movement documents; Reg. 1760/2000 beef labelling. Nothing new beyond K19 (BDN/SIAN covered); SCIA/recognition detail not confirmed in sources.

coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K19 (not re-searched per instructions).

See candidate.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction

Earthing/lightning: DPR 462/2001 every 2 or 5 years. Work equipment: D.Lgs. 81/2008 art.71 + Allegato VII, DM 11 Apr 2011, first verification requested from INAIL at least 60 days before due date. coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K04 (not re-searched).

Dealers keep a load/unload register, verify buyer patentino, and file an annual sales declaration to SIAN by end of the second month after year-end. Passepartout Mexal fitofarmaci module already does register, patentino check and SIAN file. Quaderno di campagna = K09. Weak.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Albo informatico of Ministry of Labour (ANPAL abolished 1 Mar 2024), provisional authorisation 2 years; UniSomm comunicazione obbligatoria for somministrazione. Duties fall on licensed agencies, already served by payroll/agency suites. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Funeral homes = K06 (rejected). Municipal cemetery concession expiry tracking (DPR 285/1990 art.92, local regulations; comuni publish lists of expired concessions; votive-lamp billing) - searches returned only foreign cemetery software; no Italian product confirmed. Buyer is the comune or concessionaire, not a private small firm. Unverified candidate.

coverage.found: RUNTS: DM 2/2026 extends yearly member/volunteer/employee data communication to all associative ETS (deadline 30 Jun 2026, passed) and sets bilancio deposit within 180 days of year-end; Modello E aggregated from FY2026; changes to be registered within 30 days. CSVs help associations for free; commercial gestionali exist (Asso360, custom EUR 1,200 offer). Halal/kosher supervision not searched.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Taxi/NCC: RENT register created by DM 203 of 2 Jul 2024, comuni verify data; electronic service sheet (DM 226/2024) annulled by TAR Lazio ruling 15273 of 4 Aug 2025 and frozen. Trucking: Albo + REN with periodic MIT telematic checks and mass revocations; REN registration needed for 2027-2031 incentives; from 1 Jul 2026 vans 2.5-3.5 t in international/cabotage haulage need G2V2 tachograph (MIT circolare 9674 of 16 Apr 2026). Tachograph download/fleet software dominated by Geotab, Frotcom and others.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Market traders: nothing new beyond K19. Money changers: only the virtual-currency section of the OAM register turned up; quarterly OAM reporting for such operators ended with Q3 2025 per OAM circular 55/24 (verify). No traditional currency-exchange duty found.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Tattoo/piercing: regional rules (Piedmont: individual client sheet and consent kept 5 years; Lombardy L.38/2013 etc.), Stato-Regioni 2007 baseline; no national filing. Driving schools: Dylog Linea Patente and patente.it Gestione dominate. Hunting outfitters: Piedmont AFV/AATV report culling data to region by 28 Feb 2026 through the Nembo platform; regional and tiny. Childminders/nurseries and small food producers not searched (not_reached).
